articles.title: Medusa Lattice
articles.summary: Pink and magenta ribbons of glowing lace sweeping in waves over black, like jellyfish frills. Reads as flowing pink-magenta waves on black, a loud jellyfish-silk swirl; the rib cuts vanish and the bright-dark wave rhythm remains.
articles.what: Polar jelly lace pulsing bioluminescent heartbeat rings outward Up close: Sweeping curved bands, each cut crosswise into short ribbed segments that glow hot pink in the middle and fade to near-black at the ends, like lit tube lanterns. Thin grey-violet grid lines cross the bands; dark magenta gaps separate the waves. Bands are 30-60 px wide. From a distance: Reads as flowing pink-magenta waves on black, a loud jellyfish-silk swirl; the rib cuts vanish and the bright-dark wave rhythm remains. Measured spec (average): metal 124, roughness 111, coat 173. Shine: satin. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.

Not a hologram: no colour travel, one pink family
Avoid: small numbers over the ribbons, next to other loud pink finishes.
